label: Diagram 2.21
caption: Diagram 2.21 Wall type 2 – tied junction | – external cavity wall with internal masonry wall
description: The drawing is an isometric line diagram headed "Diagram 2.21 Wall type 2 – tied junction – external cavity wall with internal masonry wall". The external cavity wall runs across the back of the drawing. Coming towards the viewer from it is the separating wall, two leaves of masonry with a cavity between them, labelled "Separating wall type 2" on its front face. Where the separating wall meets the external wall, a small hatched block closes the external wall's cavity, labelled "Cavity stop". To the right, a single leaf of masonry blocks labelled "Internal masonry wall" also runs from the external wall, and a leader line marked "Tied junction" points to the ties at the top where it meets the inner leaf of the external wall.
first_draft: The drawing is an isometric line diagram headed "Diagram 2.21 Wall type 2 – tied junction – external cavity wall with internal masonry wall". It depicts two leaf walls of masonry blocks meeting at a junction. The left-hand wall is drawn as an external cavity wall, with a vertical gap between its leaves; this gap is closed at the top by a small hatched block pointed to by the label "Cavity stop". A leader line marked "Tied junction" indicates the top of the junction where the two walls overlap and are connected. The right-hand leaf, shown as rectangular masonry blocks laid in horizontal courses, is labelled "Internal masonry wall". A further leader line, "Separating wall type 2", points to the lower body of the junction. The two walls are shown intersecting at right angles, with the internal masonry wall forming the corner of the junction and the external cavity wall running off to the left.

check.note: Mixes up the walls: "Separating wall type 2" is the two-leaf wall coming towards the viewer; the external cavity wall runs across the back and the internal masonry wall is the single leaf on the right.

model_description: The drawing is an isometric line diagram headed "Diagram 2.21 Wall type 2 – tied junction – external cavity wall with internal masonry wall". It depicts an external cavity wall (two leaves) meeting a single-leaf internal masonry wall at a right-angle junction. The left-hand wall is drawn as an external cavity wall, with a vertical gap between its leaves; this gap is closed at the top by a small hatched block pointed to by the label "Cavity stop". A leader line marked "Tied junction" indicates the top of the junction where the inner leaf of the cavity wall is tied to the internal masonry wall. The right-hand wall, a single leaf of rectangular masonry blocks laid in horizontal courses, is labelled "Internal masonry wall". A further leader line, "Separating wall type 2", points to the front face of this internal masonry wall. The two walls are shown intersecting at right angles, with the external cavity wall running off to the left and the internal masonry wall running off to the right.
